entry.hypothesis: H7 - 60/40 whose equity leg moves to BIL (or IEF) while SPY's 6/12-month excess return is negative keeps 60/40's return with a shallower drawdown, so its Sharpe is higher.
entry.rationale: The decisive benchmark's drawdowns are equity bear markets, which trend (Faber 2007; Antonacci's GEM switch); filtering only the equity leg targets that failure mode without the basis risk of the whole universe. Trend-family, registered separately because it tests the filter on the benchmark's own composition.

pbo.caveat: only 4 trials — at this width the estimate has a standard deviation around 0.2-0.3 even when the true value is 0.5, so read it as a direction, not a number. Values between 0.2 and 0.8 do not distinguish a real edge from noise here.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
